entries.zh: 锦袄；长衣（锦缎面的长袄）
entries.en: a long garment of brocade; a brocade jacket

entries.zh: 直摆；衣摆平直的长袍
entries.en: a long robe with straight side-panels (straight-hemmed robe)

entries.zh: 衫仔；衣衫（中国料子做的衣裳）
entries.en: a shirt; a garment of Chinese cloth

entries.zh: 短衫仔；短上衣
entries.en: a short shirt (short jacket)
entries.notes: M 栏末另有未比定音节 coan（或为另词），不影响本条释义。

entries.zh: 粗绸衣；碎布条缝成的衣裳
entries.en: a garment made of shreds/strips; coarse silk clothing
entries.notes: H 第二字「窓」难以比定，释义以 L「hecho a hilachas」（碎条制成）与「紬」（残丝粗绸）为主。

entries.zh: 绣补；绣有补子的衣裳（贵者所服）
entries.en: an embroidered garment worn by princes; embroidered rank insignia

entries.zh: 棕蓑；棕榈蓑衣（防雨蔽水之衣）
entries.en: a rain cape of palm fibre (garment worn against water/rain)

entries.zh: 素整；素净齐整的衣着（合宜之服）
entries.en: plain, tidy attire; suitable dress

entries.zh: 襦仔；贴身短袄（素而无外饰之衣）
entries.en: a short jacket; plain inner garment
entries.notes: L「sin asomo」（无外露/无外饰）与「襦仔」的对应系据义推断。

entries.zh: 服色；衣着（寻常中等之服）
entries.en: attire; ordinary dress

entries.zh: 褴褛；衣裳肮脏破烂
entries.en: dirty and ragged clothing; tattered dress

entries.zh: 穿；穿衣（着衣）
entries.en: to dress; to put on (clothes)
entries.notes: M 栏另记 un、chion 两音节而 H 仅作「穿」，或兼记短语，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 借用；借衣穿着
entries.en: to borrow (clothes) for use
entries.notes: L「vestirse profanamente」与「借用」的对应关系存疑，释义据 H/M 取「借穿」义。

entries.zh: 穿衣裳；穿衣
entries.en: to dress oneself; to put on clothes

entries.zh: 妆饰；梳妆打扮（修饰仪容）
entries.en: to adorn and groom oneself; to dress up

entries.zh: 奢华；穿着奢华（虚饰炫服）
entries.en: to dress vainly/luxuriously; extravagance

entries.zh: 奢侈；穿着奢侈
entries.en: to dress extravagantly; luxury

entries.zh: 罩于头顶的头衣（兜帽类）〔释义存疑：西语 caguella 与汉字「凹头」对应待考〕
entries.en: a hood-like covering worn over the head ('caguella', sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L「caguella」为罕见词形无法比定，仅知其罩于头顶；H「凹头」/M「tap gau」与之对应无法确证，故降为 low。

entries.zh: 纹；纹理（纹路）
entries.en: vein; grain/streak (of cloth or material)

entries.zh: 直纹；布料的直向纹理（如所附样品）
entries.en: straight grain of cloth, as in this sample
